The collection

Fourteen paintings and prints, from a 1495 Japanese ink landscape to Matisse and Kandinsky. Every one is in the public domain. Pick one to paint your photo in its style, or read about it first.

  • The Starry Night

    Vincent van Gogh, 1889

    Swirling night sky in deep blues and bright yellows, with thick, rhythmic brushstrokes.

    Use this style: The Starry Night About this painting: The Starry Night

  • The Scream

    Edvard Munch, 1893

    Blood-orange sky and wavering lines in an Expressionist cry of anxiety.

    Use this style: The Scream About this painting: The Scream

  • The Great Wave off Kanagawa

    Katsushika Hokusai, c. 1831

    Japanese woodblock print of a towering wave in Prussian blue and white.

    Use this style: The Great Wave off Kanagawa About this painting: The Great Wave off Kanagawa

  • The Wreck of a Transport Ship

    J. M. W. Turner, c. 1810

    Storm-tossed sea in amber, brown and smoky grey, with loose, turbulent brushwork.

    Use this style: The Wreck of a Transport Ship About this painting: The Wreck of a Transport Ship

  • Udnie (Young American Girl, The Dance)

    Francis Picabia, 1913

    Fragmented, interlocking planes in grey, black, blue and green, close to abstraction.

    Use this style: Udnie (Young American Girl, The Dance) About this painting: Udnie (Young American Girl, The Dance)

  • Improvisation 27 (Garden of Love II)

    Wassily Kandinsky, 1912

    Loose abstract shapes in soft reds, yellows and greens on a pale ground.

    Use this style: Improvisation 27 (Garden of Love II) About this painting: Improvisation 27 (Garden of Love II)

  • The Large Blue Horses

    Franz Marc, 1911

    Three blue horses against red and yellow hills, painted in bold, flat colour.

    Use this style: The Large Blue Horses About this painting: The Large Blue Horses

  • The Kiss

    Gustav Klimt, 1907–1908

    Embracing lovers in gold leaf and patterned robes on a meadow of flowers.

    Use this style: The Kiss About this painting: The Kiss

  • A Sunday on La Grande Jatte

    Georges Seurat, 1884–1886

    Riverside park scene built from small dots of pure colour.

    Use this style: A Sunday on La Grande Jatte About this painting: A Sunday on La Grande Jatte

  • Woman with a Hat

    Henri Matisse, 1905

    Portrait in free, unnatural colour: teal, green, orange and violet patches.

    Use this style: Woman with a Hat About this painting: Woman with a Hat

  • Café Terrace at Night

    Vincent van Gogh, 1888

    Lamp-lit café terrace under a starry blue sky, in warm yellows and oranges.

    Use this style: Café Terrace at Night About this painting: Café Terrace at Night

  • Zodiac

    Alphonse Mucha, 1896

    Art Nouveau poster: flowing hair and ornament in peach, terracotta and gold.

    Use this style: Zodiac About this painting: Zodiac

  • Sloop, Nassau

    Winslow Homer, 1899

    Sailing boat on a choppy sea, in loose watercolour washes of teal, grey and white.

    Use this style: Sloop, Nassau About this painting: Sloop, Nassau

  • Splashed-Ink Landscape

    Sesshū Tōyō, 1495

    Misty mountain landscape in splashed grey and black ink on pale paper.
